exposure: Hairy polyp (HP) in the oropharyngeal region
outcome: Successful surgical removal of the polyp
cohort: The study describes a single newborn girl presenting with acute respiratory distress.
finding: Hairy polyp in the oropharyngeal region should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute respiratory distress in infants, and a transoral surgical approach can achieve successful and minimally invasive excision even in newborns.
